🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No kinetic targeting decisions automated without human-in-the-loop approval at appropriate command level
  • ❌ No special operations intelligence fused with civilian datasets without DPIS and ISC approval
  • ❌ No space command AI decisions affecting allied satellites without NATO Space Centre coordination
  • ❌ No offensive cyber operations launched without Ministerial authorisation and JSC-level oversight
  • ❌ No intelligence sharing with non-Five Eyes partners without formal treaty and DPIS clearance
  • ❌ No procurement AI recommendation actioned without independent cost assurance and NAO audit trail
